about: How each persisted SRAM label is treated when a save is converted (SAVE_COMPATIBILITY_RUNBOOK.md). Keys are full-match regexes over SRAM labels; tools/save_schema.py check fails on any label none of them covers. continue: preserve (copy; translate if the layout changed), header (written by the converter), scratch (contents never read across a load; copied as-is). recovery: keep (permanent progress, carried into the recovery save), template (taken from the target build's post-reset Dorm save, i.e. what a run reset leaves), field (inside the main save block: decided per saved-WRAM field, see recovery_keep_wram).

sSaveHeader.*.why: identifies the layout; the converter writes the target's

sSpriteBuffer[012].why: picture decompression buffers, rewritten before every use

sFusionDiagBuf.why: fusion sprite diagonal-tile buffer, rewritten per draw

sTurnRewindBuf.why: TURN REWIND snapshot; byte 0 $ff means none, only read in battle

sHallOfFame.why: Hall of Fame teams: a permanent record

sProc(Cave|Cemetery|Forest).*.why: the current run's procedural stage, kept together with its run events

sStageEvent.*.why: stage-event placement for the live wild area

sStolen.*.why: theft record, dies with the wild-area visit

sDebugFight2.*.why: debug-only FIGHT 2 fixture; release code never reads it

sTMBitfield.why: TM/HM ownership; ClearTMBitfield at run reset

sKeyItemsBitfield|sKeyItemTiers.why: key items and their upgrade tiers survive run resets (meta-progression)

sElementPrismType|sPrismCartridges.why: ELEMENT PRISM choice and cartridges, cross-run

sGameData|sPlayerName|sMainData|sSpriteD.why: the main save block (copies of saved WRAM and HRAM)

sMainDataCheckSum.why: recomputed by the converter after any change

sFinalTeamArchive.*.why: champion teams for the final AI encounter, cross-run, own checksums

sBox([1-9]|1[0-2])|sBank[23](AllBoxesChe.why: PC boxes; EmptyAllSRAMBoxes at run reset

sFallenLog|sFallenLogEnd.why: Ironman fallen log; FallenLogClear at run reset

sRogueOfferDVs|sRogueOfferDVTag|sRogueOf.why: reward offer DVs, keyed by species tag; any stale value is a valid pair, cleared at new game

recovery_keep_wram.about: Saved-WRAM fields a recovery carries from the old save into the target's post-reset Dorm template. Everything else in the main save block comes from the template. Measured against RogueResetRunState: see SAVE_COMPATIBILITY_RUNBOOK.md, 'Recovery parity'.
recovery_keep_wram.event_bytes: persistent zone: wEventFlags bytes below RUN_EVENTS_START/8 and from RUN_EVENTS_END/8 on
